svg.title: Transition-metal complex shapes and isomerism
svg.desc: Four panels compare six-coordinate octahedral, four-coordinate tetrahedral, square-planar cisplatin with adjacent chloride ligands, and linear Tollens [Ag(NH3)2]+ geometry. A lower strip distinguishes octahedral cis/trans positions, shows a tris-chelate optical mirror cue, and separates coordination-sphere cis/trans descriptors from E/Z nomenclature for suitable multiple-bond stereochemistry.
svg.text: A tetrahedron has no cis/trans pair.
The two Cl ligands are adjacent (cis).
Two NH₃ ligands face opposite sides.
This is the complex in Tollens’ reagent.
Full 3D pair in linked octahedral art.
Opposite wraps: mirror images, not superimposable.
relative positions in the ligand sphere.
